name: llamaparse-mcp-eu
description: Unlock document processing and Index v2 retrieval workflows with the LlamaParse Platform MCP (Europe region)

interface.shortDescription: Unlock document processing and Index v2 retrieval workflows with the LlamaParse Platform MCP (Europe region)
interface.longDescription: Connect your agent to the LlamaParse Platform MCP in the Europe region and unlock access to document processing tools like Parse, Split and Classify, plus agentic retrieval over Index v2 knowledge bases. Use this plugin if your LlamaCloud account lives on cloud.eu.llamaindex.ai; accounts on cloud.llamaindex.ai should install llamaparse-mcp instead.
defaultPrompt: Use the LlamaParse MCP when in need for document processing utilities to parse, split or classify a document.
Use the LlamaParse MCP Index v2 tools when a question should be answered from documents stored in a LlamaCloud Index v2 knowledge base.
